meaning: Implemented means source plus local tests, not real Chrome approval. This is a bounded cross-layer audit, not proof every possible gap is closed.

findings.finding: Direct evidence was labeled FYI; source metadata was hidden.
findings.action: DIRECT badge plus bounded safe source/method disclosure; producer omissions remain explicit.

findings.finding: Heuristic percentages can be mistaken for measured probabilities.
findings.action: Panel displays evidence scores /100 and explicit qualifier; auto-toast copy remains owner review.

findings.finding: Long evidence lists lacked safe filtering and visibility counts.
findings.action: Render cap 300, search 100 characters, severity filter and hidden-item counts; scores unaffected.

findings.finding: Display preferences absent and could overwrite protection settings if shared.
findings.action: Validated local separate-key theme/density/text-size; serialized writes and reset only appearance.

findings.finding: Small low-contrast text and fixed minimum width.
findings.action: Minimum 12px base text, light/system themes, focus styles, 44px buttons, narrow-width CSS; eight contrast pairs pass, no layout/screen-reader claim.

findings.finding: No bounded current-scan share/export with deliberate data exclusions.
findings.action: Public HTTPS scan only; schema/value guards, query/token/email redaction, first 300 allowlisted items; native download intent only tested in DOM harness.

findings.finding: Refund processing time, negated fees and ordinary RMA steps inflated return-policy risk.
findings.action: Explicit short return deadlines, fee negation, informational contact/RMA and inspection; one policy source lineage.

findings.finding: Domain younger than claimed business age was scored as deception.
findings.action: Domain/business age mismatch informational with zero weight; no business-age conclusion.

findings.finding: Pronoun us, incidental return-policy geography and partial roles could imply a complete foreign chain.
findings.action: Shared jurisdiction aliases, destination-specific roles and partial-coverage labels; geographic weight remains zero.

findings.finding: Malformed samples, provider aliases and generic complaint words could manufacture corroboration.
findings.action: Validate ratings/counts/share; provider-host canonicalization, snippet dedupe, required negative phrasing and shared reputation ancestry.

findings.finding: Product ratings versus merchant-service ratings treated as directly comparable.
findings.action: Score only known matching scope and subject ID; uncertain comparisons remain informational.

findings.finding: Credential-free recall service not available to a shopper as a bounded candidate tool.
findings.action: User-selected public query and field; direct permission chain, cancel before/after grant, 8s/2MB limits, stale-report guards; no scoring.

findings.finding: Transitive development graph not locked; CI used npm install.
findings.action: Exact package-lock and npm ci; clean Node 22 install passes; LinkeDOM dev-only ISC, no runtime dependencies.

findings.finding: New UI/API surfaces need bounded and adversarial regression coverage.
findings.action: 30 added tests, 215 total; caps, malformed payloads, hostile URLs, consent cancellation and chunked oversize responses.

findings.finding: Eligible research entries could be mistaken for implemented APIs.
findings.action: Nine capability dispositions including existing RDAP; FTC scope corrected and openFDA conflicting auth text retained as unresolved.

findings.finding: Core feature settings trust arbitrary saved values and use overlapping load/save actions.
findings.action: Typed validation plus atomic patch/update queue needed; separate display settings do not repair core consent flags.

findings.finding: Source hunt generates 10 destinations but opens first eight, dropping POD and Reddit silently.
findings.action: Keep bounded tabs; expose selected batches/remaining destinations and accurately describe coverage.

findings.finding: RDAP cache path returns cached result before pending permission decision resolves.
findings.action: Await permission before showing cache; denial and pending-request error paths need meaningful tests. Static finding, no Chrome breach alleged.

findings.finding: RDAP redirects and registrable-domain resolution not established.
findings.action: Verify bootstrap/endpoint policy, permissions and registered root on multi-label suffixes/subdomains; current query only strips www.

findings.finding: RDAP button status still implies seller-story conflict for informational domain age.
findings.action: Change owning panel status to factual domain chronology with business-age limitation.

findings.finding: Many producers lack provenance; source disclosure cannot reconstruct missing observations.
findings.action: Add extraction source and method at production time; do not fabricate metadata or count missing metadata as exoneration.

findings.finding: Actual Chrome install, consent lifecycle, download, visual reflow and focus behavior unavailable.
findings.action: 0 real Chrome tests. Full QA package must run in Chrome 133+ before release.

findings.finding: No representative labeled evaluation establishes category accuracy or calibration.
findings.action: Synthetic regression guards behavior, not population precision/recall or physical product quality. Maintain abstention.

findings.finding: Research corpora require freshness, identifiers, licenses and deployment dispositions.
findings.action: Retain first-sweep 174-record integration map; new API states and probe receipts checkpointed. No automatic signed feed or full-page archival implementation.

findings.finding: Etsy hostname literal has doubled escaping.
findings.action: RUNTIME-AUDIT-01 retained; exact literal fails etsy.com in Node, adapter Chrome path not performed.

findings.finding: Visible price literal has doubled escaping.
findings.action: RUNTIME-AUDIT-02 retained; exact literal misses $29.99 / 29.99 USD; no Chrome product test.

findings.finding: First Product/Offer extraction may select recommendation/other variant.
findings.action: RUNTIME-AUDIT-03 retained; release-critical recommendation-first / ProductGroup / selected-variant fixtures and real Chrome required.
